How Kiro Sequences Tasks Automatically

Kiro decides what to build first — and it's usually right.
Tasks get ordered by dependency, not by guesswork.
Foundational pieces — schemas, core logic — come before UI polish.
You can reorder, but the default sequence already avoids most rework.

Episode 27 of theAIgurukul's free Kiro series, a daily short on AWS's agentic IDE. Subscribe for the next one.
